items.headline: Anthropic ka Nasdaq debut, valuation $2 trillion
items.detail: Anthropic ke share Nasdaq debut par $111.50 par khule — IPO price $83 se 34% upar; din bhar me company ki valuation $2 trillion tak pahunchi, AI company ka ab tak ka sabse bada IPO.
items.exam_angle: AI companies, IPO records — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Kerch Bridge par teesra hamla, Putin ne badle ki dhamki
items.detail: Ukraine ne chaar din me teesri baar Kerch Bridge par hamla kiya, rail seva ruk gayi; Putin ne bahut zyada dardnak jawab ki dhamki di aur samudri-urja yuddh-viram ki baat khatm kar di.

items.headline: Berlin me Ukraine sahyogiyon ki badi baithak
items.detail: Zelenskyy Berlin pahunche; 40 se zyada sahyogi deshon ke neta Coalition of the Willing baithak me mile, shanti vartao me Europe ki bhumika aur suraksha guarantee par charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine war, European security — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kushner: Russia ko NATO-jaisi guarantee manzoor
items.detail: America ke doot Jared Kushner ne Berlin me kaha ki Russia ko Ukraine ke liye NATO ke Article 5 jaisi suraksha guarantee manzoor hai aur Trump bhi iske liye taiyaar hain; Russia ne abhi is par kuch nahi kaha.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine war, NATO Article 5 — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ne divangat Pete Rose ko maafi di
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne baseball ke sabse zyada hit (4,256) banane wale divangat Pete Rose ko tax mamle me poori maafi de di; Rose ko 1990 me tax jhooth bolne par saza hui thi aur woh 2024 me guzar gaye the.

items.headline: China ko 9 lakh AI chip ki manzoori
items.detail: America ne December 2025 se May 2026 tak Nvidia aur AMD ke lagbhag 8,79,000 advanced AI chip China ko bechne ki manzoori di, jinme Alibaba ke 75,000 aur Tencent ke 1,50,000 chip shamil hain.
items.exam_angle: US-China tech war, export controls — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Gaza me Israel ka pehla zameeni hamla
items.detail: Yuddh-viram ke baad pehli baar Israel ne madhya Gaza me zameeni karvai ki, Yellow Line se aage Nuseirat ke paas ek surang ko nishana banaya; teen log mare gaye aur hazaaron phir se beghar hue, karvai 19 November ko poori hui.

items.headline: UN pramukh ki race atki, neta ka sankat
items.detail: Suraksha Parishad aath daur ke gupt matdan ke baad bhi Guterres ke uttaradhikari par sahmat nahi ho payi, aur 31 December ko unka karyakal khatm hone par UN bina pramukh ke reh sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: UN Secretary-General selection, UNSC — UPSC IR
